summary: CONTEXT: build the scariest unknown first. Ranked Stripe highest risk, schema medium, CRUD lowest. A spike is a time-boxed throwaway that answers one question. SkillSwap without payments is not a product; W7/W8 belong before polished search.
evidence: Oil-well: test well before pipeline. UI-first startup hit 100 req/h API vs 10k needed; three months of frontend trash.
Ranking matches expected: payment (external) > schema (lasting, owned) > CRUD (familiar). Risk is unknowns, not hours.
Spike: hours, throwaway, one question — e.g. Stripe test charge+refund vs U-F8 clocks.
Tied to DAG: do not staff W5 search first; W7 payment iface is the test well.
